10. Write a balanced chemical equation of decomposition reaction which is carried out by the catalyst.
Ans:- A common decomposition reaction carried out by a catalyst is the decomposition of hydrogen peroxide in the presence
of manganese dioxide. Balanced chemical equation:
2H2O2 → (MnO2)→ 2H2O + O2
Here, manganese dioxide (MnO₂) acts as a catalyst and increases the rate of decomposition without being consumed.

2. Write the types of given chemical reaction .
i) C + O2 → CO2
ii) 2KClO3 → 2KCl + 3O2
Ans:- C + O2 → CO2 is a combination reaction because two substances carbon and oxygen combine to form a single product
carbon dioxide. And 2KClO3 → 2KCl + 3O2 is a decomposition reaction because a single compound potassium chlorate
breaks down into simpler substances potassium chloride and oxygen gas.
3. Write the balanced chemical reaction between Aluminium metal and dilute hydrochloric acid. Mention the type of reaction
with reason.
Ans:- The balanced chemical reaction between Aluminium metal and dilute hydrochloric acid is 2Al + 6HCl→ 2AlCl3 + 3H2.
The type of reaction is single displacement reaction because Aluminium is more reactive than Hydrogen so it displaces
Hydrogen from dilute hydrochloric acid, forming Aluminium Chloride and Hydrogen gas.
4. Write the following word equation into balanced formula equation.
Nitric acid + Calcium Hydroxide → Calcium nitrate + water
Ans:- The balanced chemical formula equation of given word equation is 2HNO3 + Ca(OH)3 → Ca(NO3)2 + 2H2𝑂.
5. Write any two characteristics of catalyst.
Ans:- Any two characteristics of a catalyst are
1. A catalyst changes the rate of a chemical reaction without itself undergoing any permanent chemical change.
2. A catalyst does not get consumed in the reaction and can be reused after the reaction is completed.
